sections.title: What Are Dental Implants?
sections.html:
Understanding Dental Implants

What Are Dental Implants?

A dental implant is a small titanium post that is surgically placed into the jawbone to replace the root of a missing tooth. Once the implant integrates with the bone (a process called osseointegration), a custom-made crown is attached to create a natural-looking, fully functional replacement tooth.

Unlike dentures or bridges, dental implants London patients receive are fixed solutions that don't slip, don't require adhesives, and preserve the surrounding healthy teeth. They stimulate the jawbone just like natural tooth roots, preventing the bone loss that commonly occurs after tooth loss.

At our dental implant clinics in South Kensington and the City of London, we use only premium titanium implants with zirconia crowns, ensuring durability, biocompatibility, and a natural aesthetic that blends seamlessly with your existing teeth.

Dental Implants vs Alternatives

Implants: Can last 20+ years with proper care, preserve bone, feel natural
Bridges: Require grinding healthy teeth, last 10-15 years
Dentures: Can slip, accelerate bone loss, need replacing

Implant Treatments

Dental Implant Services London

Free 15-Min Chat1-Hour Consultation
01

Single Tooth Implant

Our most popular treatment for replacing one missing tooth. A titanium implant is surgically placed into your jawbone, where it fuses naturally over 3-6 months. We then attach a custom-made zirconia crown that matches your existing teeth perfectly. Unlike bridges, single implants don't require grinding down healthy adjacent teeth, preserving your natural tooth structure. Prices start from £2,950 including implant, abutment, and crown.

02

All-on-4 / All-on-6

Revolutionary full-arch restoration using just 4 or 6 strategically angled implants to support a complete set of teeth. All-on-4 is ideal for patients with moderate bone loss, while All-on-6 provides extra stability for those who grind their teeth or want maximum durability. Many patients receive their new teeth the same day as surgery. This treatment eliminates loose dentures and can significantly improve chewing efficiency.

03

Implant-Retained Dentures

Transform your existing loose dentures into a secure, stable solution. We place 2-4 implants per arch that 'snap' onto your denture using special attachments. This prevents embarrassing slipping during eating or speaking, eliminates the need for messy denture adhesives, and significantly improves chewing efficiency. Your dentures remain removable for easy cleaning while providing the confidence of a fixed solution.

04

Bone Grafting & Sinus Lifts

Don't let bone loss stop you from getting dental implants. Our experienced dentists perform advanced bone grafting procedures to rebuild lost jawbone, creating a solid foundation for implants. Sinus lift surgery is available for upper jaw implants where the sinus cavity has expanded. Using the latest regenerative techniques and biocompatible materials, we can often make implants possible even in complex cases other clinics have turned away.

sections.html:
Treatment Process

How Dental Implants Work

Understanding the dental implant procedure helps you make informed decisions. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how we place dental implants at our London clinic.

"Proper care ensures dental implants serve as a long-lasting solution for missing teeth."

View Dental Implant Costs →Conditions We Treat →
Step 01

Initial Consultation

Your journey starts with a consultation, including CT scans and X-rays, to check your eligibility and devise a personalised treatment plan for you.

Step 02

Implant Placement

A titanium implant is placed surgically into the jawbone, functioning as a secure tooth root. Recovery takes 3-6 months with a temporary denture provided.

Step 03

Abutment Attachment

After healing, an abutment is placed onto the implant, offering the stable foundation required for your final crown.

Step 04

Crown Placement

A custom made crown is then fitted on your teeth, restoring the full function and natural aesthetics of your smile.

Implant Lifespan

Dental Implant Longevity

With proper care, dental implants are designed to last many years. The key to their durability lies in the osseointegration process, the fusion between your jawbone and the titanium implant, which creates a strong, stable foundation.

Regular hygiene appointments and dental check-ups are essential for maximising your implant's lifespan. Many of our dental implant patients in London enjoy their implants for over 20+ years. Individual results depend on oral hygiene, lifestyle, and regular maintenance.

sections.title: Dental Implants London FAQs
sections.html:
FAQs

Dental Implants London FAQs

Got questions about dental implants in London? Find answers below or visit our full FAQ page.

What Are Dental Implants?
A dental implant is a titanium screw placed directly into the jawbone. Over time, it fuses with the bone and functions as an artificial tooth root to support crowns, bridges, or dentures.
Why are Dental Implants Needed?
They provide a long-term solution for missing teeth, helping to prevent bone loss, restore chewing function, and improve aesthetics compared to traditional dentures.
Are dental Implants safe?
Yes, dental implants are a well-established, proven treatment. We use biocompatible titanium implants that integrate safely with your body.
Are dental implants painful?
The procedure is performed under local anesthesia, so you shouldn't feel pain during surgery. Post-operative discomfort is usually manageable with over-the-counter medication.
How long do dental implants last?
With proper care and oral hygiene, dental implants are designed for long-term use. Studies show success rates of over 95% at 10 years. Individual results depend on oral health, lifestyle, and maintenance.
